subject: Alignment: POC cadence, stakeholder intro, and calendar sync
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Alignment: POC cadence, stakeholder intro, and calendar sync

Hi Elena —

Great to meet today — thanks for the thoughtful product fit questions. Quick recap from my side and a couple of concrete next steps so we can lock in a technical deep dive: 

Recap (short):
- Goal: 4-week POC to validate inference latency and cost targets for a batch of customer-facing features.
- Success metrics: <=120ms median tail latency at 95th perc., < $0.0009/token rendered in production config, and functional parity for reranking flows.
- Key stakeholders: Elena (Analytics), Jared (Procurement), Security (TBD), Platform/Infra (your side).

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our solutions engineer to scope the POC integration, sample data, and deployment options. Can you confirm which of these slots work for your team?
- Wed Nov 11 — 10:00–11:30 AM PST
- Thu Nov 12 — 2:00–3:30 PM PST

If either time works, I’ll send an invite and loop in the internal folks who’ll run the technical session (cc’d Stephanie). Also, if you can include the procurement and security contacts on your side in the thread, we’ll attach a short mutual action plan and SOC2 checklist so procurement/security can triage early.

I’m attaching a one-page POC outline (Redwood-POC-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx) to give a rough agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.

— Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+karthik@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood-POC-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@acme-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme-analytics.com>, security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment: POC cadence, stakeholder intro, and calendar sync

Thanks, Karthik — this looks good.

We’d like to move forward with a technical deep dive. Thu Nov 12 2:00–3:30 PM PST works best for us (that slot fits the infra and analytics leads). Looping in Jared from procurement and our security mailbox so they can see the plan and flag any immediate concerns. Jared — can you confirm if Acme needs a redline or if we should start with standard terms + SOW?

Security team — I’d appreciate a quick look at the SOC2 checklist you mentioned. We’ll aim to have the procurement and security review completed in parallel with the tech session.

Elena
Director, Analytics — Acme Analytics
elena@acme-analytics.com | +1 (617) 555-0789
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@acme-analytics.com>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme-analytics.com>, security@acme-analytics.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment: POC cadence, stakeholder intro, and calendar sync

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Jared/security in.

Confirming Thu Nov 12, 2:00–3:30 PM PST for the technical deep dive. I’ve tentatively booked that slot; you should receive a calendar invite in the next 5 minutes.

Who’s joining from Acme on the call? (helps us allocate the right engineers):
- Elena Rossi — Analytics (confirmed)
- Jared Cole — Procurement (cc’d)
- Security inbox — please add the security lead if possible

Internal attendees from Redwood: Laura Bennett (Solutions Engineer) — will lead the tech demo and integration checklist; Monica Patel (Security & Compliance) — will own the SOC2 discussion and evidence needs; Stephanie Nguyen — will run success criteria and timeline.

Attached: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf — this is a short intake checklist Monica will use to triage required artifacts ahead of the POC. It’s helpful if your security team can pre-fill the environment/inventory sections before the call.

Action items before the deep dive:
1) Acme: add your security lead or confirm contact (security@acme-analytics.com is fine for now).
2) Acme: procurement — confirm if you need a redline or can start from our standard terms.
3) Both teams: review the attached mutual action plan and the SOC2 intake doc.

Invite will include a dial-in + a short shared Drive folder for POC artifacts. Link to the draft action plan: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ApoC-example-POC-map

See you Thursday — I’ll also drop a brief agenda in the invite.

— Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@acme-analytics.com>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@acme-analytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment: POC cadence, stakeholder intro, and calendar sync

Hi all — I’ll take point on the security checklist and will join the deep dive on Thursday. Quick asks from our side to make the call efficient: 

- Can Acme share a short inventory of data classes that will be used during the POC (PII, internal-only, third-party) ahead of the call? A one-sheet is fine.
- If you have any existing network allowlist requirements for vendor IPs, please share so Laura and I can validate connectivity plans.

I’ve reviewed the SOC2-evidence-request.pdf and highlighted two items we typically need pre-call: access controls matrix + sample retention policy. If you can upload those to the Drive folder before Thu, we’ll be able to give more concrete answers during the session.

Thanks — Monica
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
